rawDescription: Innovation often comes from the places you'd least expect, and that's the story of The Huascarán – a sustainable puffer jacket built from two unlikely materials. The shell and lining use Pertex® fabrics with NetPlus® recycled nylon, made from discarded fishing nets off the coast of South America, giving you lightweight and packable protection while helping reduce ocean plastic pollution. Our patented PAKAFILL® insulation blends ethical alpaca fiber with recycled polyester for warmth without bulk. This retro-mountaineering-inspired jacket has angled front pockets that sit clear of your harness, with an interior chest and mesh glove pockets that hold what you actually use. Adjustable cuffs and a bottom hem cinch system seal out the cold, and a 2-way zipper lets you adapt as conditions change. The uniquely woven face fabric repels rain and snow, and a 2-way zipper lets you adapt as conditions change, whether you're climbing, skiing or commuting.

title: Baby alpaca fur hat — Blanco 100

shipping.summary: Ships internationally from Peru (EMS); import duties not included

rawDescription:
Material: 100% Peruvian Baby Alpaca fur
Origin: Cusco, Peruvian Andes
The baby alpaca fur hat is the warmest —and noblest— answer to a mountain winter. The natural fur wraps the head in a dense softness no synthetic fabric matches, and its natural tones, never repeated from one piece to the next, give every hat a character of its own.
It is made with baby alpaca fur from the Peruvian Andes, soft to the touch and hypoallergenic. The natural fiber retains body heat even at the lowest temperatures, which makes this hat an ally on days of hard cold without giving up elegance.
Our furrier makes it by hand in Cusco, from recovering the pelt to the finished hat. Made in Peru.
Ethical commitment: we never kill alpacas for their fur. We only use the pelts of young alpacas that died from weather or health causes, almost always because they did not survive the friaje, the cold snaps of the Cusco highlands.
How to wear it: over a coat with sober lines, for a warm and refined winter look. Its natural tones work with any palette.
Care: keep dry. Clean with a soft cloth. Do not machine wash or submerge.
